name: Adam Internet
summary: Major South Australian ISP, acquired by iiNet in 2013 (ADAM INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 055 495 853).

events.details: Founded as an ISP (origins: Adelaide Amiga Club 1986, BBS 1987, commercial TBBS 1989); founding predates the archive, earliest Wayback capture 20 Dec 1996.
Acquired by iiNet for ~$60 million; customers moved to iiNet 2015.
